name: motordata
description: The open source API for Motorsport data

scripts.validate: bash -c 'for schema in $(find schemas -type f -name "*.schema.json"); do series=$(basename $(dirname "$schema")); schema_name=$(basename "$schema" .schema.json); if [ -d "data/$series" ]; then find "data/$series" -type f -name "$schema_name.json" | while read -r data_file; do ajv validate -s "$schema" -d "$data_file" -c ajv-formats || exit 1; done; fi; done'

author: vishwapramuditha
